title: Asset repository
interface: class AssetRepository(conn); attribute conn. create(asset_tag, type, brand, model, serial_number, purchase_date, price, notes, location_id=None, condition='good', supplier='', warranty_until='', cost_center='', invoice_id=None) -> dict (asset_tag upper-cased/stripped; status 'in_stock'; updated_at=now; raises sqlite3.IntegrityError on duplicate tag — do NOT catch). get(id) -> dict | None. get_by_tag(tag) -> dict | None (case-insensitive). update(id, **fields) -> dict | None: columns asset_tag, type, brand, model, serial_number, purchase_date, price, notes, location_id, condition, supplier, warranty_until, cost_center, invoice_id (None allowed for location_id/invoice_id); sets updated_at; ignores unknown keys. set_status(id, status) -> bool (ValueError for unknown status). list_all(status=None, type=None) -> list[dict] by asset_tag. search(q) -> list[dict] matching asset_tag/brand/model/serial_number. search_assets(q='', status=None, type=None, location_id=None, tag_id=None, employee_id=None, invoice_id=None, warranty_before=None, sort='asset_tag') -> list[dict]: one SQL query joining locations (location_name), the open assignment + employee (holder_email, holder_name, holder_employee_id — None when unassigned), filtered by every given argument (tag_id via asset_tags; employee_id via the open assignment; warranty_before: warranty_until != '' AND warranty_until <= value; q matches asset_tag/brand/model/serial_number LIKE, case-insensitive); sort is one of asset_tag, type, brand, model, status, created_at, updated_at, warranty_until, purchase_date, optionally prefixed with '-' for DESC; unknown sort -> asset_tag. count_by(field) -> dict[value, count] for field in ('status','type','condition','location_id'). Dict keys: id, asset_tag, type, brand, model, serial_number, purchase_date, price (float), status, notes, created_at, location_id, condition, supplier, warranty_until, cost_center, invoice_id, updated_at (+ location_name/holder_* from search_assets). the repository receives a sqlite3.Connection in the constructor (no default) and calls conn.commit() after every write; rows are plain dicts

uses.schema: src/db.py: SCHEMA — tables employees, locations(id,name,address,notes), tags(id,name,color), invoices(id,number,supplier,issued_at,total,currency,notes,created_by,created_at), asset_tags(asset_id,tag_id), assets(+location_id, condition, supplier, warranty_until, cost_center, invoice_id, updated_at), handovers, assignments, audit_log, attachments(id,owner_type,owner_id,kind,filename,stored_name,mime_type,size,uploaded_by,uploaded_at), settings
uses.config constants: src/config.py: ASSET_TYPES, ASSET_STATUSES, ASSET_CONDITIONS, TAG_COLORS, ATTACHMENT_KINDS, ATTACHMENT_OWNERS, ATTACHMENT_ALLOWED_TYPES, HANDOVER_KINDS, HANDOVER_STATUSES
